Give this single carton the central half of the board, large enough that its barcode remains clearly legible. It is a small cereal carton with one blue circle above its one barcode. Do not show a second copy or any invented code.
Around it add ONLY: at left, one full-body Kit and one full-body adult shop worker standing side by side for relative scale. Kit is the boy ONLY from SECOND reference: golden light-medium skin, short side-parted black hair, teal shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. Worker has deep brown skin, short tightly curled black hair, plain green short-sleeved shirt, dark navy trousers and dark shoes; adult taller than child. At right, separated simple props: one dark navy handheld checkout scanner with a red window and curved grip on its small desk stand, and one gray rectangular desktop monitor with entirely blank pale screen. Small pale-gray countertop location key under scanner/monitor. No Zoe or other people, no food, no bags, no duplicate poses, no future events. White background, generous clean separation. Bold clean 2D children's cartoon, crisp continuous dark outlines and strictly flat uniform colors; no grain, paper texture or mottling, no shadows across barcode. Entirely unlettered: no letters, numerals, captions, logos or title. Precision aid, NEVER PRINT: barcode exactly 95 modules, 1 black/0 white: 10101100010011011000010100011010000101010001101010111001010011101001110111001011011001001000101. Preserve the supplied barcode artwork intact and draw only around it.
